ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; white pixels are concentrated on the distal lateral lobes, while black pixels dominate the central peduncle and medial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on the distal regions of both lobes (Left: ~X 0.05-0.35, Right: ~X 0.65-0.95); these zones contain high-density black punctate mottling and localized circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along 90% of the trailing edge; amplitude increases to high-intensity jaggedness at the distal tips due to localized protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular dark pixel groupings located on the distal white sections of both lobes, particularly concentrated at the far right tip area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 5-7 parallel, vertical dark linear marks (rake-like patterns) cutting through the white pigmentation on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions at both distal tips consistent with heavy barnacle colonization; the trailing edge shows localized irregular nicks and jagged disruptions beyond standard serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical 'streak' patterns of dark pigmentation extending from the trailing edge into the white field on the right lobe.
